Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api
Package persistence.tools

Interface SchemaExporter

public interface SchemaExporter
Contract for generating and exporting offline DDL scripts from a JPA entity metamodel at build time without requiring a live database connection or running database server.

Implementations inspect compiled JPA entity classes and generate schema definition statements (such as table definitions, primary keys, foreign key constraints, and indexes) or schema teardown statements tailored to a configured database dialect.

Usage Example


 SchemaExporterFactory factory = SchemaExporterFactory.newSchemaExporterFactory("3.1");
 SchemaExporter exporter = factory.newSchemaExporter(
     List.of("com.example.model.Product", "com.example.model.Supplier"),
     Map.of("hibernate.dialect", "org.hibernate.dialect.PostgreSQLDialect")
 );

 // Export schema creation statements to a DDL file
 exporter.export(SchemaExporter.Action.CREATE, new File("build/schema/create-schema.sql"));
